title: Jackson Stone Drops Latest Hit Single “Way 2 Gifted”
htmlContent:
California-based rapper, singer and producer Jackson Stone is set to take the music scene by storm with the release of his latest single, “Way 2 Gifted”, and accompanying music video. Hailing from the vibrant city of Oakland, Stone is known for his innovative approach to hip-hop, seamlessly blending influences from various genres to craft a sound uniquely his own.

“Way 2 Gifted” serves as a tantalising preview of Stone's upcoming project, The Bloomer Collection Vol. 3, which marks the beginning of a musical journey culminating in his highly anticipated album, Late Bloomer. As an emerging artist, Stone's trajectory promises a bright future that music enthusiasts won't want to overlook.

The single, born out of Stone's inspiration from a transformative trip to Cabo, is a testament to his diverse creative process."I started with the infectious chords, added the head-bobbing beat behind, and then came with the catchy melody",says Stone, illustrating the organic evolution of the track.

“Way 2 Gifted” is more than just a musical composition; it is a personal narrative for Stone, conveying a message of inspiration and resilience. Stone shares, "This track is a reminder to me or anyone to always chase your dreams and use the gifts I was given. A reminder that there will be obstacles and things that try to get me off track, but as long as I stay gifted, I'll be exactly where I am supposed to be."

Jackson Stone's ability to seamlessly weave his life experiences into his music sets him apart in the competitive world of hip-hop. “Way 2 Gifted” invites listeners to join Stone on a journey of self-discovery and determination, making it a must-listen for fans of innovative and soulful hip-hop. “Way 2 Gifted” is available to buy/stream now on all platforms.
